messages.content: "296 :     public boolean isUnixSymlink() {\n297 :         return (getUnixMode() & UnixStat.LINK_FLAG) == UnixStat.LINK_FLAG;\n298 :     }"

Title: Diagnosis

Details:  
The failing test is checking if the method `isUnixSymlink()` returns `false` for an entry in the Zip file "COMPRESS-379.jar" where more than one Unix permission flag is set. The test expects `isUnixSymlink()` to return `false` for the entry `"META-INF/maven/"`. 

Examining the method `ZipArchiveEntry.isUnixSymlink()`, it checks if the Unix mode of the entry has the Unix symlink flag set by using the expression `(getUnixMode() & UnixStat.LINK_FLAG) == UnixStat.LINK_FLAG`. This means it returns `true` if *any* bits that correspond to `LINK_FLAG` are set in the Unix mode, regardless of any other bits.

The `getUnixMode()` method returns the Unix mode extracted from the external attributes field of the Zip entry if the platform is UNIX, otherwise 0. The Unix mode is masked as `(getExternalAttributes() >> SHORT_SHIFT) & SHORT_MASK`, but the exact bit shifts are not crucial here.

`UnixStat.LINK_FLAG` is set to octal `0120000`, which corresponds to the symlink file type bit mask in Unix file modes.

From the current bug report, it mentions that the zip entry has a very broad Unix permission "177777". This means multiple flags are set including the symlink flag and possibly others. Since the current `isUnixSymlink()` only checks if the symlink bit is set, it would return `true` even if additional flags are set, which is incorrect according to the test case.

Thus, the core of the problem is that `isUnixSymlink()` should only return `true` if the Unix mode _exclusively_ indicates a symlink, not just if the symlink bit is present among others. The current implementation returns `true` when the symlink bit is present but does not check that no other conflicting bits are set.

This explains why the test `isUnixSymlinkIsFalseIfMoreThanOneFlagIsSet()` fails: the entry has multiple flags set, and the current method wrongly returns `true` for `isUnixSymlink()`.

There are no recent related bug reports directly pertaining to this issue, so this diagnosis is primarily based on the test case and current bug report.

Recommendation: Change the `isUnixSymlink()` method to check that the Unix mode matches exactly the symlink flag and not any other bits (or at least ensure no other conflicting mode bits are set).

The faulty method is:
- `ZipArchiveEntry.isUnixSymlink()`
org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.zip.ZipArchiveEntry.isUnixSymlink()

Based on the available information, provide the signatures of the most likely culprit methods for the bug. Your answer will be processed automatically, so make sure to only answer with the accurate signatures of all likely culprits (in `ClassName.MethodName(ArgType1, ArgType2, ...)` format), without commentary (one per line).
